# Monthly IC Memo — 2026-10

Session SESSION_MONTHLY_IC · 2026-10-03 · Aldrich (JUDGE), for the IC
Scope: second monthly IC. The packet still aggregates inception-to-date (fund start 2026-07-11), so figures below are inception-to-date unless labelled "month" (window since the 2026-09-05 IC, i.e. the four scored kills dated on/after 09-05).

sections.heading: Posture
sections.markdown: Both books remain fully in cash for a **third consecutive month**: GLOBAL **cash 100.0%, deployment 0.0%**, INDO same, governor **NONE** in both, max drawdown **−0.01% (GLOBAL) / 0.0% (INDO)**, zero live theses, zero orders. The compliance block is unchanged except that "cash above the 40% ceiling" is no longer a fresh flag but a standing state. The September owner-directed engine fixes are reflected where they act: no thesis died in lint this month (judged_unticketed sits at 3 — ERAA PASS_REDUCED deferred on a feed gap, NVO-002 re-test, and the legacy 0700HK PASS_REDUCED), and the month closed with 7 KILLs rather than two months of a no-pass wall. The pipeline has throughput; it still has zero deployment.

sections.heading: Returns vs benchmark
sections.markdown: Still not applicable in the ordinary sense — no positions, so nothing to attribute; all attribution/factor/sector blocks are empty and book performance remains cash-yield accrual only. The month's realised "return" is again the **opportunity cost of the cash posture**, not a number. The decision-useful evidence is the kill ledger.

sections.heading: What the ledger shows
sections.markdown:
**31 kills inception-to-date** (7 this month: TSM 09-16, AAPL 09-16, MSFT 09-28, QCOM 09-28, and BAC/MS/JSMR.JK decided today, unscored at print). Of the **28 with a post-kill print, 16 avoided further loss and 12 left gains on the table**; avg scored kill trades **+1.1%** above its kill price (compressed from last month's +7.0% as early counterfactuals decayed and new kills arrived at zero). Inception reason mix: **other 12, valuation 10, process 6, liquidity 1, fragile_estimates 1, base_rate 1**.

**Month window (4 scored):**

| Ticker | Killed | Reason | vs kill |
|---|---|---|---|
| QCOM | 09-28 | base_rate | **−8.5%** |
| AAPL | 09-16 | other | +0.7% |

### What worked

- **Base-rate kills are earning.** QCOM, killed on base_rate at 201.97, trades **−8.5%** five sessions later — the first clean same-month avoid-loss in fund history. The base_rate lane, used for the first time, worked exactly as designed.
- **The re-test lane is live and disciplined.** NVO-002 is the first true post-LESSON-0002 re-test (TXN-style, run against a fresh thesis after the 07-13 process kill); it sits judged-unticketed rather than auto-killed. No repeat-kill was fired this month without a fresh pass — the LESSON-0002 discipline held.
- **No bad capital deployed, still.** 31 consecutive KILL/zero-size outcomes, zero losses ever. The avoid-loss tail (16/28) continues to exceed the miss tail by count, even as average miss has compressed.

### What didn't

- **The complex-blind spot migrated to GLOBAL tractors.** The month's worst miss is TSM **+14.3%** (killed 09-16 "other" at 413.75), riding the AI-capEx re-rating while the name's own near-term P&L was the kill basis — the same shape as the INDO agri lesson one sleeve over (AMD **+30.9%** and TXN-002 +7.9% from August are the sibling cases; 3 scored kills against the AI-infra complex since 08-19). The complex is never inside the frame for GLOBAL semis/AI-compute the way PROPOSAL-2026-09-01 will put it into the frame for IDX commodities. Routed to consolidation (see below).
- **"other" is the plurality kill reason (12/31).** A kill tag that means "miscellaneous" this often is a signal that verdicts are not being typed tightly; worth watching alongside calibration once n grows.
- **Zero deployment for a third month at a full-cash carry.** GLOBAL cash proxies ~3.63% (3.88% post-09-15/16 hike) against a tape the macro desk persists CAUTIOUS on; the cash decision is now incontestably a *choice*, and the choice's cost runs two months deep.

sections.markdown:
1. **Deployment is still the objective, and the blockers are now mechanical, not judgmental.** Resolve the ERAA feed + open-thesis ADV coverage (both already in the owner's attention queue) so the ERAA PASS_REDUCED and any NVO-002 pass can print a size. A third month of zero deployment after the engine fixes would indict the post-decision path, not the analysis.
2. **Ratify PROPOSAL-2026-09-05 (SIZING_EV_BASE_RATES out-of-cycle edit).** Owner-directed, replicable from repo state, and this month's output is consistent with it — theses are now failing or passing on judgment rather than dying in lint arithmetic. Ratification recorded in PENDING_METHOD_PATCHES; the card stands.
3. **Apply PROPOSAL-2026-09-01 (VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL)** — the DSNG/TAPG/LSIP counterfactuals (≥2-case bar, three cases) are on the record; the IDX agri lens formally carries the complex inside the frame. Routed to consolidation this IC.
4. **Commission the GLOBAL AI-infra analogue.** TSM/AAPL/AAPL-adjacent in-sleeve misses (with AMD, TXN-002) meet the ≥2-case bar; consolidation should add the semis/AI-compute complex inside the valuation frame to ANALYST_GLOBAL/BEAR and consider whether a shared complex-carry rule replaces the sleeve-specific pair.
5. **Keep the teeth that work:** base_rate kill lane, re-test discipline (LESSON-0002), fragile-estimates gate, liquidity veto.
6. **Calibration stays the gap.** No closed P&L after three months means Judge/Bear calibration, hit rates, and archetype scoring remain unevidenced; expect a calibration rule the moment the first closed outcomes exist.
7. Fees verification current (last verified 2026-07-06, 12-month cycle, not due). No action.
